card: Adds test vectors to script_tests.json covering signature and public key encoding edge cases in the script interpreter. Mutation testing on bitcoincore.space showed that six live mutants in interpreter.cpp survived the test suite, leaving boundary conditions unexercised in signature length limits, signature total-length checks, single-byte null R and S encoding, and pubkey prefix validation. Four of the covered checks affect DERSIG consensus rules, one affects STRICTENC policy rules, and one lower-bound check prevents an out-of-bounds read on small signatures under AddressSanitizer. No dependencies.
evidence: The PR description identifies six live mutants from mutation testing on bitcoincore.space (interpreter.cpp#5168, #5191, #5200, #5232, #5259, #5186) that survived the existing test suite.

The commit log and description note that four mutants alter consensus checks in IsValidSignatureEncoding, one affects policy in IsCompressedOrUncompressedPubKey, and one tests the signature lower-bound check that protects against an out-of-bounds read caught under AddressSanitizer.
problem: Boundary conditions in signature and public key canonical encoding verification were untested in script_tests.json, allowing artificial mutations in consensus- and policy-critical interpreter logic to pass the test suite undetected.
summary: Adds new test cases to the script interpreter test vectors in script_tests.json. The tests cover signature and public key validation edge cases in interpreter.cpp, specifically targeting DERSIG encoding checks and STRICTENC public key prefix validation.
